title: Benchmark registry
description: Closed schema for benchmark registry files (shipped reference/benchmarks.json and team rows). Rows hold pointers only: no scores, no rankings, no model names.

note.description: Optional summary of this registry file.

id.description: Unique lowercase identifier for the benchmark row.

link.description: HTTPS URL of the benchmark leaderboard or results page.

publisher.description: Publishing organization or site. Two boards from one publisher count as one source.

provider_own.description: True when the publisher is a model provider reporting its own evaluations; supports only that provider's models.

status.description: Trust tier of the row. New rows start support-only and become permanent after passing longevity, accuracy and coverage.

task_set.description: Underlying task set identifier. One task set hosted on two sites counts as one source.

expect.description: Substring expected in a real rendered or markdown page body so an empty shell is detected.

freshness_seconds.description: Optional cache freshness window in seconds. Defaults to 86400 (one day).

enabled.description: When false, the row is skipped during fetch and decision.
